title: Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That Outperforms Google’s TimesFM-3
summary: Mistral released Timestral, a time series foundation model family from 5M to 209M parameters. The 209M model leads GIFT-Eval, TIME and fev-bench among zero-shot models and runs on CPU. The post Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That Outperforms Google’s TimesFM-3 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
